title: Dependency Graphs of Mathematical Arguments: Representation, Structural Measurement, and Proof Review
abstract: arXiv:2610.36776v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a source-grounded framework for representing and measuring mathematical arguments with assistance from large language models. It includes numbered and unnumbered statements, equations, assumptions, and constructions, distinguishing source occurrences from contextual states and inference records. Proposed dependencies retain source evidence and review status. A measurement contract fixes manuscript versions, boundaries, granularity, proof choices, and macro anchors. On a selected finite directed acyclic graph, depth is the longest prerequisite-path length, and bulk counts distinct ancestor edges. We give a union recurrence that accounts for shared subarguments and identify reachability conditions preserving depth and the macro skeleton; unrestricted refinement need not preserve depth or bulk. A standardized, versioned prompt protocol separates annotation discovery, deterministic recomputation, and review assistance. Cross-paper

translated_title: 数学论证的依赖图：表示、结构度量与证明审阅
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个以源文本为依据、在大语言模型辅助下表示和度量数学论证的框架。该框架涵盖有编号与无编号的命题、公式、假设及构造，并区分源头出现、上下文状态与推理记录。所提出的依赖关系保留源头证据和审阅状态。度量契约固定手稿版本、边界、粒度、证明选择和宏观锚点。在选定的有限有向无环图上，深度定义为最长前提路径的长度，体量则统计不同的祖先边数量。我们给出了一个考虑共享子论证的并集递推式，并识别出保持深度和宏观骨架的可达性条件；不受限制的细化不一定能保持深度或体量。一套标准化、带版本管理的提示词协议将标注发现、确定性重算与审阅辅助相互分离。
tldr: 提出了一个基于源文本、借助大语言模型辅助的数学论证依赖图表示与度量框架，通过深度与体量等结构指标、并集递推式及可达性保持条件，并配合标准化版本化提示协议，实现可靠的证明审阅。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a source-grounded, LLM-assisted framework that represents mathematical arguments as dependency graphs and measures their structure via depth and bulk, with union recurrences, reachability preservation conditions, and a standardized versioned prompt protocol enabling rigorous proof review.
